concerns.text: The primary dataset `nebius/SWE-rebench-V2-PRs` is assumed to contain a sufficient number of LLM‑generated pull requests for binary comparison, yet there is no citation or evidence that this benchmark includes LLM‑generated code. Using a dataset that may lack the target provenance signals could invalidate the provenance classification (FR‑002) and downstream statistical tests.

The plan asserts that all steps are CPU‑tractable on the GitHub Actions free tier (2 CPU, ≤7 GB RAM, ≤6 h) but provides no estimate of the raw dataset size or memory footprint. If the parquet file exceeds the available RAM, the scripts may fail, violating SC‑005. Include a size estimate or chunked‑processing strategy to guarantee feasibility.
